'''??Pinky Lemon??''' is a secret piece of [[furniture]] obtained by placing [[Duck Mayonnaise]] in the partially hidden purple box in the back room of [[The Stardrop Saloon]]. Once placed, it can be moved by holding left-click, or by using a [[Tools|tool]].
